system.description: Once per day, at the start of your turn, remove all conditions currently affecting the Monk (stunned, paralysed, poisoned, feared, charmed, etc.) and heal 4d8 HP. Using this ability does not cost an action and can be used even while incapacitated.

activities.name: Body of Iron Made Whole
activities.text: At the start of your turn, remove all conditions affecting you and heal 4d8 HP, with no action needed.
